events.title: CPI in November
events.rules: If the Consumer Price Index (CPI) increases by more than -0.3% (single-decimal) in November 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.

events.title: CPI in December
events.rules: If the Consumer Price Index (CPI) increases by more than -0.1% in December 2026, as reported to one decimal place, then the market resolves to Yes.

events.title: CPI YoY in November
events.rules: If the Consumer Price Index (CPI) increases by more than 3.0% in the twelve months ending November 2026 (as represented by the one-decimal place value reported by the Bureau of Labor Statistics), then the market resolves to Yes.

events.title: CPI YoY in December
events.rules: If the Consumer Price Index (CPI) increases by more than 3.0% in the twelve months ending December 2026 (as represented by the one-decimal place value reported by the Bureau of Labor Statistics), then the market resolves to Yes.
